items.comments: What a lovely home - perfect for our group!

We had a great experience at Kristin's home. The house was very nice and suited our needs. The neighborhood was a bit quieter and cozier than we expected so we felt we had to be quieter than usual hanging out outside, but the stay was still a great one. Would recommend this home!

Thank you for the wonderful, relaxing, and productive stay at the bungalow.  My student pals and I were finishing up some last minute papers, and this space was exactly the escape what we needed to get focused and relax. Everything was as pictured and described.  Communication was a breeze.
Really enjoyed our stay in Madrone. The home was as advertised. It was convenient and had all the amenities. Would enjoy staying there for a longer time.
The house is beautiful and exactly as advertised, if not better. We had 6 people for a weekend and it was the perfect size. Would not hesitate to stay here again.
